title: Nullified Typings  [Cobblemon/Mega]
description: Nullifies all pokemon type advantages in Cobblemon... I don't know why you'd want to? Have fun, I guess.
body:
This datapack nullifies all type advantages that pokemon typically have (in Cobblemon). Nothing will be ineffective or supereffective against anything else. 

**Requires**: Mega Showdown, and Cobblemon.

It also subsequently changes how hidden power inherent type IVs are done. 

Have fun!
